title.narrative: Niger - Public Sector Capacity and Performance for Service Delivery Project

description.narrative: The objective of the Public Sector Capacity and Performance for Service Delivery Project for Niger is to strengthen public sector performance in selected ministries/sectors. These include: planning, finance, civil service, agriculture, hydraulic, health, education, mining and energy, interior, and Prime Minister's office. There are two components to the project, the first component being supporting programs for service delivery results. The project will carry out a program of activities identified in selected eligible expenditures programs to address core public sector capacity and system deficits and apply improved capacity and systems to targeted ministries, including, inter alia: core public sector reforms, agricultural sector, public health, and education. Finally, the second component is the technical assistance for capacity development. This component will complement the first component by financing selected inputs for which resources are not readily available in the national budget or for which the government has requested more intensive supervision support. Funding of this component will not be linked to Disbursement Linked Indicators (DLIs). It will finance IT systems and equipment and technical assistance.
The revised project development objective is 'to strengthen public finance and human resource management to improve service delivery capacity in selected sectors'.

title.narrative: Share of public sector agents paid through the Human Resource Management Information System (HRMIS)
Expenditure outturn in education and health
Public investement selection and monitoring system

baseline.value: Decree on the selection of public investment projects (PIM) and guidelines.

target.value: Report on the implementation of the public investment projects published (covering 2014-19).

actual.value: Not achieved. The online platform that would house a comprehensive database of internally and externally funded public investment programs could not be fully operationalized due to delays in the adoption of the PIM strategy.

title.narrative: Biometric census of public sector agents

baseline.value: No consolidated census, multiple identity systems.

target.value: Audit report of the HRMIS for 2019 is available.

actual.value: Not achieved. The biometric census of public agents was completed and the data cleanup process is still ongoing, to be finalized in2022.

title.narrative: Pilot incentive system for improving staff deployment in the education sector

target.value: Impact assessment and strategy to scale-up the pilot incentive system available.

actual.value: Not achieved. The pilot was delayed due to COVID19 and the reorganization of the Ministry of Education.

baseline.value: Procurement management information system (PMIS) not operational. Statistics not available.

target.value: Performance audits (2014 and onwards) of public procurement published.

actual.value: Achieved. Reports are published on the ARMP website.

title.narrative: HR and wage regulations, procedures and information management systems

baseline.value: Regulatory framework and information systems obsolete.

target.value: HRMIS deployed in targeted Ministries (Finance, Plan, Civil Service, Health and Education - basic, secondary and higher) at the regional level.

actual.value: Not achieved. Due to delays in carrying out feasibility studies which were further accentuated by the COVID-19 pandemic. ToRs were prepared.
